subject.title: feat: expose message topics in the web app

question: Should ClickClack support topic selection and topic-filtered channel pagination as a permanent web and TypeScript SDK capability?
rationale: This is a new user-facing organization workflow that broadens public API and SDK surface; correctness evidence alone cannot decide whether that product contract should be maintained long term.

options.title: Adopt the topic workflow
options.body: Approve the additive web, API, and SDK direction, preserving the existing numeric `channels.messages` call form for compatibility.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Request a reduced patch that keeps the desired UI behavior while limiting or deferring the public SDK pagination expansion.

options.title: Defer the workflow
options.body: Keep topics API-only until a maintainer-sponsored message-organization direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Adopt the topic workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the additive web, API, and SDK direction, preserving the existing numeric `channels.messages` call form for compatibility.
